body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (currently amended): A vehicle control device configured to control a vehicle, comprising:
an information provision device configured to provide information to a driver of the vehicle;
a processor, during automated driving control of the vehicle, configured to:perform the automated driving control by automatically performing a driving operation of the vehicle relating to a driving plan of the vehicle control device, the automated driving control comprising operations relating to at least one of acceleration,
steering, and braking, according to the driving plan;provide, through the information provision device to the driver, a driving event that is to occur at a point ahead in a direction of advance from a current point, based on an automated driving plan;
judge a suitability of whether a driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being performed by the driver at a point before the point of the driving event is acceptable to be performed,the driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being a lane change, and the driver driving operation being a lane change at the point before the point of the driving event; andprovide the driver with judgment information indicating that the driver not perform the driver driving operation, based on the judging of the suitability determining that
performing the driver driving operation is unsuitable unacceptable according to the driving plan being executed by the vehicle control device, the judgment information comprising lane change inhibiting information indicating that a lane to be changed to is unable to be driven on at the between the point before the point of the driving event and the point of the driving event due to at least one of a lane blockage or ending of the lane to be changed to.
2. (canceled)
3. (currently amended): The vehicle control device according to claim 1, wherein the processor is further configured to:
display, on an information display screen visible to the driver, as the lane change inhibiting information, a specialized icon showing that the lane to be changed to is to at least one of disappear due to the lane a lane reduction and be unable to be driven on at the point before the point of the driving event.
4. (currently amended): The vehicle control device according to claim 1, wherein the processor is further configured to:
display, on an information display screen visible to the driver, as the lane change inhibiting information, the lane to be changed to is to at least one of disappear due to the lane a lane reduction and be unable to be driven on at the point before the point of the driving event.
5. (currently amended): The vehicle control device according to claim 1, wherein the processor is further configured to:
provide to the driver, together with the lane change inhibiting information, distance information from the current point to the point where the lane to be changed to is to at least one of disappear due to the lane a lane reduction and be unable to be driven.
